subject: USAGE clause
notes: The MESSAGE-TAG usage is the DATA half of the asynchronous messaging facility, a processor-dependent element (ISO 4.2.6; Annex A.3 item 4) this implementation does not provide - the owner decision is recorded in docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 4 item 1, alongside SEND/RECEIVE. It is REFUSED BY NAME (COBOL1943), not accepted inert like those statements, because GR9 fixes the class AND category of a message-tag data item as message-tag: an accepted item would have to bind as some other class and every reference to it would answer wrong. Both spellings are refused - 13.18.60.2 prints [ USAGE IS ] as optional, so bare 01 M MESSAGE-TAG. is the same clause. Before kb/Work PB487 the bare spelling was not refused at all: it fell to the 13.16.2 catch-all, bound with no usage and no PICTURE, and crashed the compiler.
